tools.name: nanoparse_fetch
tools.description: Read one URL into clean Markdown with Litmus signals (source authority, freshness, structural trust). Price: $0.005 per page actually read, USDC on Base via x402. Free tier: 10 free parses a month, no account and no key. On a cloud host (where the anonymous allowance does not apply) pass wallet_addr

tools.name: nanoparse_status
tools.description: Check wallet balance, USDC balance, quota state, and whether the next /fetch call will succeed without payment. Use before spending — tells the agent exactly how much to fund.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "nanoparse_fetch" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
